final_model_training_dates_scope: Grey-box v1 only; this retained compatibility field does not define frozen Static/ARX fitting data.
role_warning: Preprocessing identification_use denotes a permitted pool, not the final model fitting split. 03-21 informed ARX selection and is not its unseen holdout.

T_tank_measured.evidence: measured tank-water temperature; conditional water-side proxy, NOT measured collector inlet

Tamb.evidence: gridded 2 m ambient-air-temperature proxy, NOT onsite measurement

G.evidence: reviewed irradiance channel, not a measured absorbed heat flux

P.evidence: reviewed electrical active power; model heat-subtraction assumption is separate

flow_mL_min.evidence: participant-prescribed operating flow, NOT a measured flow time series

mapping_exclusions.2026-03-18: thermal-only auxiliary; no automatic physical mapping

clock_quality: accepted candidate alignment; not independently calibrated synchronization
aggregation_semantics: 60 s arithmetic means, minimum fraction 0.8; preserve event/QC audit rows; no interpolation of insufficient experimental windows
weather_mapping: hourly provider temperature time-linearly interpolated at experimental window midpoint; no extrapolation; missing or >1.5 native-interval bracket stays missing
weather_source_limit: Archived source states IFS; exact model selector/version and API URL were not preserved
scientific_scope: interface checking only; no raw QC rebuild, parameter replay, prediction scoring, or physical validation
